key_facts.quote: Den einfachen Festzuschuss von 1.104,00 € haben wir im Heil- und Kostenplan vermerkt.

items.title: Decide whether to object (Widerspruch) to the rejection of the increased subsidy
items.action: If you disagree with the decision, file a written objection (Widerspruch) with Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse, or have it recorded in person (zur Niederschrift), by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, the decision becomes final and you will only receive the standard subsidy of €1,104.00 instead of the doubled hardship subsidy.
items.quote: Wenn Sie mit dieser Entscheidung nicht einverstanden sind, können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch bei der Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.

remedy.quote: Wenn Sie mit dieser Entscheidung nicht einverstanden sind, können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch bei der Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.

data.tax_note: Dental implant costs not covered by the statutory subsidy may be deductible as extraordinary medical expenses (außergewöhnliche Belastungen) in your tax return; keep this letter and the invoices.
data.title: Rejection of the increased (doubled) dental implant subsidy
data.summary: Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse informs Johanna Beispielacker that it cannot grant the doubled hardship subsidy (Festzuschuss) for her dental implants because her income exceeds the hardship threshold; it has recorded the standard subsidy of €1,104.00 in her treatment and cost plan (Heil- und Kostenplan). She may file an objection (Widerspruch) within the deadline the app will show.
data.explanation: Your health insurer decided you don't qualify for the doubled subsidy toward your dental implants because of your income, and recorded the lower standard subsidy of €1,104.00 instead. If you disagree, you can file a written objection (Widerspruch) with Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse, or have it recorded in person; the app will show you the exact deadline. If you do nothing, the decision becomes final and only the standard subsidy applies. Since this concerns a legal decision by a public insurer, consider checking your income figures or seeking advice (e.g. from a patient advice service) before the deadline if you think the calculation is wrong.
